summary: An announcement from BBN of a planned release of IMPSYS 2600, a major new IMP program, for May 15, 1972. It would be tried on an experimental basis and the older IMPSYS 2514 reloaded if problems occurred. Sites were asked to help load a new tape and avoid scheduling production work during the switchover. It was replaced by RFC 343.

eli5.summary: The people who run the network's traffic machines said they would swap in new software on one day. They asked everyone to help and not to plan important work then, in case it went wrong.

questions: how was the new imp software rolled out
